messages.subject: ggmap Map Designs
parts:
Hello!

I'm trying to plot points (with lat/long values) on a map using ggmap.

When reading the "ggmap: Spatial Visualization with ggplot2" (Kahle and Wickham), they talk about using CloudMade maps for flexibility. However Cloud Made is no longer giving out APIs I believe (see their email response below).

I'm simply looking for a map which is white for water and grey for land, with a black outline of land masses. Can anybody suggest a repository for map designs or a place I could make this myself?

Any help is greatly appreciated,

Cheers


CloudMade Support Email:
....
Unfortunately CloudMade can not help with your request because we no longer support service of Map Tiles, Geocoding, Routing and Vector Stream Server APIs to any API keys that are not registered to an enterprise account. Enterprise accounts are available to users making more than 10 million transactions per month. Please check our website support page http://support.cloudmade.com/ for more information.
